_notes._about: Strict JSON does not allow // comments, so documentation lives in this _notes block (for the permissions arrays, which can only hold strings) and in _comment fields on each hook matcher block further down.
_notes.permissions.allow: File creation/editing (Write/Edit), safe read-only inspection (cat/ls/pwd/echo/head/tail/wc/find/tree/which), network fetches (curl/wget), git read-only + safe writes (status/diff/log/show/branch/checkout/switch/add/commit/stash/restore), uv environment + package management (venv/add/remove/run/sync/lock/tree/python/tool), and activating .venv before `uv run` to silence VIRTUAL_ENV mismatch warnings.
_notes.permissions.deny: Block every non-uv install path (pip, pip3, python -m pip, uv pip install/uninstall) so pyproject.toml and uv.lock stay authoritative.
_notes.permissions.ask: Always prompt for file/directory deletion (rm/rmdir), remote shell / file transfer (ssh/scp/sftp), and destructive git operations (push/reset/rebase/merge/cherry-pick/clean).
_notes.permissions.defaultMode: default = show every permission prompt instead of silently accepting edits. Teaches students what Claude is doing on their behalf.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Log every student prompt into .claude/usage-log/ for instructor review. File contents and tool results are never logged.

PreToolUse._comment: Log every tool call (tool name + short summary only; never the tool's input contents or its output).
Before every `git commit`: auto-stage the usage log so it ships with the commit, then scan staged files for secret-like patterns (API keys, private keys, .env files).

PostToolUse._comment: Record a timestamp whenever pytest runs (any of the three usual invocations). The stale-tests Stop hook compares this timestamp against Python file mtimes.
Auto-format Python files with `ruff format` after Claude writes or edits them (invoked via uvx so it works before ruff has been added as a dev dep).

Stop._comment: Soft reminder on Stop if Python source files under src/, skills/, tests/, lib/, or utils/ have changed since the last pytest run. Does not block.
Surface `ruff check` findings on Stop as a reminder (fix with `uv run ruff check --fix`). No-op when there are no Python sources yet.
